simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR CHECK PROGRESSION
simvars.description: This SimVar is only valid during the pre-flight inspection phase of a flight, it is used to get (or set) the timer used for the inspection interaction (the circular progress bar) with a particular component. The component is identified by the given component ID/name and index. See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR EXPOSED PARTS LEVEL
simvars.description: This SimVar returns the average wear and tear level of the exposed parts of the aircraft. The SimVar does not take any ID or index, as it is based on an internal calculation which takes data from multiple different sources, like the control surfaces, engines, etc... The SimVar returns a value between 0 and 1 where a 1 means that the aircraft is fully functional and undamaged, and a value of 0 means that the aircraft is seriously damaged and potentially unflyable.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR EXPOSED PARTS LOWEST LEVEL
simvars.description: This SimVar returns the lowest wear and tear level of the exposed parts of the aircraft. The SimVar does not take any ID or index, as it is based on an internal calculation which takes data from multiple different sources, like the control surfaces, engines, etc... The SimVar returns a value between 0 and 1 where a 1 means that the aircraft is fully functional and undamaged, and a value of 0 means that the aircraft is seriously damaged and potentially unflyable.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR IS FAILED
simvars.description: This SimVar will return TRUE (1) if the given component ID/name has failed completely, ie: it's "health" has fallen to zero and the component is considered by the simulation as "broken". If the component is still functioning, regardless of how "weak" it may be, then this will return FALSE (1). See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR IS WEAK
simvars.description: This SimVar will return TRUE (1) if the given component ID/name is considered as being "weak", ie: it's "health" has fallen to a point where it could fail or break, and the compònent may have reduced functionality. If the component is not considered as "weak" (even if its wear and tear value is less than 1), then this will return FALSE (1). See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR LEVEL
simvars.description: This SimVar returns the current wear and tear level of the component or system being referenced, where a value of 1 is a fully functional and undamaged component, and a value of 0 means that the component has failed. The SimVar requires an ID value or name, and may also use an additional index value to tell the simulation exactly which one of the components of the given type you are targeting. See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: WEAR AND TEAR WEAK VALUE
simvars.description: This SimVar returns the current "weakness" level of the component or system being referenced, where a value of 1 is a fully functional (but not necessarily undamaged) component, and a value of 0 means that the component has failed. If this value is less than 1, then the component will experience reduced functionality and may also be more prone to failure and breaking. The SimVar requires an ID value or name, and may also use an additional index value to tell the simulation exactly which one of the components of the given type you are targeting. See the Wear And Tear Component IDs section for a full list of component names/IDs.

simvars.name: PARTIAL PANEL VACUUM
simvars.description: Gauge fail flag.

simvars.name: PARTIAL PANEL VERTICAL VELOCITY
simvars.description: Gauge fail flag.

simvars.name: DROPPABLE OBJECTS COUNT
simvars.description: The number of droppable objects at the station number identified by the index.

simvars.name: DROPPABLE OBJECTS TYPE
simvars.description: The type of droppable object at the station number identified by the index.

simvars.name: DROPPABLE OBJECTS UI NAME
simvars.description: The descriptive name of a droppable object, identified by its index, which is used in UI dialogs.

simvars.name: PAYLOAD STATION COUNT
simvars.description: Number of payload stations (1 to 15).

simvars.name: PAYLOAD STATION NAME
simvars.description: Descriptive name for payload station.

simvars.name: PAYLOAD STATION NUM SIMOBJECTS
simvars.description: The number of objects at the payload station.

simvars.name: PAYLOAD STATION OBJECT
simvars.description: Places the named object at the payload station identified by the index (starting from 1). The string is the Container name (refer to the title property of Simulation Object Configuration Files).

simvars.name: PAYLOAD STATION WEIGHT
simvars.description: Individual payload station weight.

simvars.name: GRAPPLE HOOK SET
simvars.description: This will return how open the grapple hook is, expressed as a Percent Over 100 where 0 is fully closed and 1 is fully open.

simvars.name: LEAD POLE SET
simvars.description: This will return how far the lead pole is extended, expressed as a Percent Over 100 where 0 is no extension and 1 is fully extended.

simvars.name: TOW CABLE RELEASE REASON
simvars.description: This will return the reason for which the tow cable was released.
units: Enum: 0: none 1: other 2: user input 3: winch at maximum angle 4: towplane has crashed 5: towplane in unsafe position 6: towplane end of climb

simvars.name: TOW CABLE TENSION
simvars.description: The tension within the tow cable expressed as a Percent Over 100, where 0 is no tension, and 1 is full tension.

simvars.name: TOW CONNECTION
simvars.description: This will return 1 (TRUE) if a towline is connected to both the tow plane or winch and the glider, or 0 (FALSE) otherwise.

simvars.name: TOW PLANE CONNECTION
simvars.description: This will return 1 (TRUE) if a towline is connected to both a tow plane and the glider, or 0 (FALSE) otherwise.

simvars.name: TOW RELEASE HANDLE
simvars.description: This will return the position of the tow release handle, expressed as Percent Over 100, where 0 is not deplyed and 1 is fully deployed.

simvars.name: TOW WINCH CONNECTION
simvars.description: This will return 1 (TRUE) if a towline is connected to both a winch and the glider, or 0 (FALSE) otherwise.

simvars.name: TAILHOOK HANDLE
simvars.description: This will return 1 (TRUE) if the tailhook handle is engaged, or 0 (FALSE) otherwise.

simvars.name: TAILHOOK POSITION
simvars.description: The amount that the tailhook is extended expressed as a Percent Over 100, where 0 is the tailhook is not extended at all, and 1 is the tail hook fully extended.

simvars.name: NIGHT VISION AVAILABLE
simvars.description: Will return whether the aircraft pilot has night vision (1, TRUE) or not (0, FALSE).

simvars.name: NIGHT VISION DISPLAYED
simvars.description: Can be use to get or set whether the night vision display is on (1, TRUE) or off (0, FALSE).

simvars.name: NIGHT VISION INTENSITY
simvars.description: Can be used to get or set the intensity of the night vision effect. When setting the intensity, values should be between 0 (lowest intensity) and 300 (highest intensity).

simvars.name: COLLECTIVE POSITION
simvars.description: The position of the helicopter collective. 0 is fully up, 100 fully depressed.

simvars.name: VORTEX RING STATE PROTECTION ASSISTANCE IMPACT
simvars.description: Indicates how much the current collective lever position has been increased by the Vortex Ring State Protection Assistance, compared to the player's input. See Note On Helicopter Vortex Ring Protection Assistance for more information.

simvars.name: DISK BANK ANGLE
simvars.description: Rotor bank angle of the given rotor index. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: DISK BANK PCT
simvars.description: Rotor bank percent of the given rotor index. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: DISK CONING PCT
simvars.description: Rotor coning percent of the given rotor index. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: DISK PITCH ANGLE
simvars.description: Rotor pitch angle of the given rotor index. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: DISK PITCH PCT
simvars.description: Rotor pitch percent of the given rotor index. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: HOVER INDUCED VELOCITY
simvars.description: The difference between average rotor inflow and outflow velocity (\(Vi_0\)) in meters per second.

simvars.name: NUMBER OF MAIN ROTORS
simvars.description: This will return the number of main rotors available for the helicopter. This will be 2 if neither [MAINROTOR] nor [SECONDARYROTOR] are flagged as tail rotors, or 1 otherwise.

simvars.name: ROTOR BRAKE ACTIVE
simvars.description: Whether the rotor brake is active (1, TRUE) or not (0, FALSE).

simvars.name: ROTOR BRAKE HANDLE POS
simvars.description: The percentage actuated of the rotor brake handle.

simvars.name: ROTOR CHIP DETECTED
simvars.description: Whether the rotor chip is detected (1,TRUE) or not (0, FALSE).

simvars.name: ROTOR CLUTCH ACTIVE
simvars.description: Whether the rotor clutch is active (1, TRUE) or not (0, FALSE).

simvars.name: ROTOR CLUTCH SWITCH POS
simvars.description: The rotor clutch switch position, either on (1 TRUE) or off (0, FALSE).

simvars.name: ROTOR COLLECTIVE BLADE PITCH PCT
simvars.description: The rotor collective blade pitch. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: ROTOR CYCLIC BLADE MAX PITCH POSITION
simvars.description: The position (angle) at which blade has the maximum cyclic pitch. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: ROTOR CYCLIC BLADE PITCH PCT
simvars.description: The rotor cyclic blade (maximum) pitch. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: ROTOR GOV ACTIVE
simvars.description: Whether the rotor governor is active (1, TRUE) or not (0, FALSE). The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the engine to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first engine (for backwards compatibility since this SimVar was changed to take an index).

simvars.name: ROTOR GOV TARGET PCT
simvars.description: Sets a target RPM as a ratio of nominal RPM for the indexed engine governor. For example, if the helicopter has a nominal RPM of 390 and its idle state RPM is 52% of this value, then setting the target value here to 0.52 will make the governor target the proper 200 RPM when idle. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the engine to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first engine (for backwards compatibility since this SimVar was changed to take an index).

simvars.name: ROTOR GOV ENGINE TRIM
simvars.description: Retrieves the trim offset percentage for the governor target RPM of the indexed engine. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the engine to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first engine (for backwards compatibility since this SimVar was changed to take an index).

simvars.name: ROTOR GOV SWITCH POS
simvars.description: The rotor governor switch position, either on (1 TRUE) or off (0, FALSE). The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the engine to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first engine (for backwards compatibility since this SimVar was changed to take an index).

simvars.name: ROTOR LATERAL TRIM PCT
simvars.description: The rotor lateral trim percentage. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: ROTOR LONGITUDINAL TRIM PCT
simvars.description: The rotor longitudinal trim percentage. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: ROTOR RADIUS
simvars.description: The radius of the indexed rotor (either 1 for the main rotor, or 2 for the secondary rotor).

simvars.name: ROTOR ROTATION ANGLE
simvars.description: Rotor rotation angle of the given rotor index. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: ROTOR RPM
simvars.description: The indexed rotor RPM. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: ROTOR RPM PCT
simvars.description: Percent max rated rpm of the given rotor index. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor.

simvars.name: ROTOR TEMPERATURE
simvars.description: The main rotor transmission temperature.

simvars.name: STRUCT ROTOR POSITION
simvars.description: The position of the indexed rotor. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor.

simvars.name: TAIL ROTOR BLADE PITCH PCT
simvars.description: The pitch position of the tailrotor blades.

simvars.name: TAIL ROTOR PEDAL POSITION
simvars.description: Percent tail rotor pedal deflection.

simvars.name: ENG ROTOR RPM
simvars.description: Returns the indexed rotor RPM. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: ENG TORQUE PERCENT
simvars.description: Returns the indexed rotor torque. The SimVar takes an index value, which is the index of the rotor to target. Note that an index of 0 will target the first rotor.

simvars.name: HELICOPTER_MASTER_THROTTLE_POSITION
simvars.description: Returns the position of the master throttle as a value between 0 and 1.

simvars.name: IS ATTACHED TO SLING
simvars.description: Set to true if this object is attached to a sling.

simvars.name: NUM SLING CABLES
simvars.description: The number of sling cables (not hoists) that are configured for the helicopter.

simvars.name: SLING ACTIVE PAYLOAD STATION
simvars.description: The payload station (identified by the value) where objects will be placed from the sling (identified by the index).

simvars.name: SLING CABLE BROKEN
simvars.description: THis will be True (1) if the indexed cable is broken, or False (0) otherwise.

simvars.name: SLING CABLE EXTENDED LENGTH
simvars.description: The length of the indexed cable extending from the aircraft.

simvars.name: SLING HOIST PERCENT DEPLOYED
simvars.description: The percentage of the full length of the sling cable deployed.

simvars.name: SLING HOIST SWITCH
simvars.description: This will be True (1) if the hoist is enabled or False (0) otherwise.

simvars.name: SLING HOOK IN PICKUP MODE
simvars.description: This will be True (1) if the hook is in pickup mode or False (0) otherwise. When True, the hook will be capable of picking up another object.

simvars.name: SLING OBJECT ATTACHED
simvars.description: If the SimVar units are set as boolean, this will return True (1) if a sling object is attached, or False (0) otherwise. If the SimVar units are set as a string, tis will return the container title of the object. Note that there can be multiple sling positions, indexed from 1. The sling positions are set in the Aircraft Configuration File.

simvars.name: CAMERA GAMEPLAY PITCH YAW
simvars.description: Returns either the pitch (index 0) or the yaw (index 1) of the current gameplay camera.

simvars.name: CAMERA REQUEST ACTION
simvars.description: This can be used to have the currently active camera perform a predefined action. Currently only 1 action is supported, but more may be added over time.
units: Enum: 1 = Reset Active Camera (in VR this will recenter the headset view)

simvars.name: CAMERA STATE
simvars.description: This can be used to get or set the camera "state", which will be one of the listed enum values. Note that not ALL possible enum values are shown, since some values are internal only, and some values will do nothing, but have been reserved for future expansion of the camera system. Also note that the value "9" is a special case, generally used only when working with in-sim panels and is used to go to the showcase cameras, defaulting to the last selected camera within this section (Drone, Fixed or Environment).
units: Enum: 2 = Cockpit 3 = External/Chase 4 = Drone 5 = Fixed on Plane 6 = Environment 7 = Six DoF 8 = Gameplay 9 = Showcase 10 = Drone Aircraft 11 = Waiting 12 = World Map 13 = Hangar RTC 14 = Hangar Custom 15 = Menu RTC 16 = In-Game RTC 17 = Replay 19 = Drone Top-Down 21 = Hangar 24 = Ground 25 = Follow Traffic Aircraft

simvars.name: CAMERA SUBSTATE
simvars.description: This variable can be used to get or set the camera "sub-state". The options here are generally only required when working with the in-sim panel UI. Note that the "locked" and "unlocked" state will be changed automatically if the following SimVars have their values changed: COCKPIT CAMERA HEADLOOK, CHASE_CAMERA_HEADLOOK.
units: Enum: 1 = Locked (Fixed look or chase lock - The camera is locked in position) 2 = Unlocked (Head look or Chase normal - The camera is "attached" to the mouse) 3 = Quickview (the camera is currently using a Quickview) 4 = Smart (The camera has Smart camera active) 5 = Instrument (The camera is focused on an instruments panel)

simvars.name: CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX
simvars.description: With this you can get or set both the type of view for the current camera, as well as the option index, which will be between 0 and the maximum index value (as retrieved using the CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX MAX SimVar). Supplying an index of 0 to the SimVar will get/set the type (from the selection of enum values listed), and using an index of 1 will get/set the option index, which is an integer value. Please see the Notes On View Types And Indices section below for more information.
units: Enum (index = 0): 0 = Unknown/default (External / Chase and Showcase / Drone / Fixed / Environment states) 1 = Pilot View (Cockpit State) 2 = Instruments (Cockpit State) 3 = Quickview (Cockpit State) 4 = Quickview External (External State) 5 = View (Showcase / Drone / Fixed / Environment states) or Number (index = 1)

simvars.name: CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX MAX
simvars.description: This variable can get the number of option indices related to a specific camera view type. The index value supplied to the SimVar should be one of the camera view type Enum values (see CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX), and the SimVar will return the number of options available for that camera type (counting from 1, so - for example - if the camera view type is "Quickview" and has 8 quickview settings, then CAMERA VIEW TYPE AND INDEX MAX:4 will return 8). Note that this value can be set after a flight has started, but it will have no effect since the number of camera options is initilaised once only and not updated (and the simulation may overwrite the value again even after setting it). Please see the Notes On View Types And Indices section below for more information.

simvars.name: DIRECTORS CUT CAMERA PITCH
simvars.description: Sets the pitch of the Director's Cut camera gimbal.

simvars.name: DIRECTORS CUT CAMERA YAW
simvars.description: Sets the yaw of the Director's Cut camera gimbal.

simvars.name: GAMEPLAY CAMERA FOCUS
simvars.description: This gets/sets the focus for the camera zoom, which can be either manual, or auto. The setting affects both the Cockpit and the External (Chase) cameras. The following SimVars can be used to get/set the level of zoom: COCKPIT CAMERA ZOOM or CHASE_CAMERA_ZOOM.

simvars.name: IS CAMERA LOCKED
simvars.description: This will return whether the camera is locked (1, TRUE) or not (0, FALSE).

simvars.name: IS CAMERA RAY INTERSECT WITH NODE
simvars.description: This SimVar is used to check for a collision along a ray from the center of the user FOV and a model node. The available nodes that can be checked using this SimVar must be previously defined in the [CAMERA_RAY_NODE_COLLISION] of the cameras.cfg file. The SimVar requires a node index value between 1 and 10, corresponding to the node defined in the CFG file, and the SimVar will return 1 (TRUE) if there is a collision along the camera ray or 0 (FALSE) otherwise. You may also supply an index of 0 to perform a collision check for all defined nodes, in which case the SimVar will return 1 (TRUE) if there is a collision between the ray and any of the defined nodes. Supplying an index outside of the range of 1 to 10, or supplying an index for which no node has been defined, will return 0 (FALSE).

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA HEADLOOK
simvars.description: This is used to get/set the look state of the chase (external) camera. Note that this value will also affect the CAMERA SUBSTATE value, when the CAMERA STATE is set to 3 (External/Chase).

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA MOMENTUM
simvars.description: Sets/gets the momentum modifier of the chase (external) camera, which is controls how fast/slow the camera will stop moving when no longer being moved by the user. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA SPEED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the translation speed modifier of the chase (external) camara, as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA ZOOM
simvars.description: Sets/gets the zoom/FOV modifier for the chase (external) camera. Note that when setting this value, it will affect the camera regardless of whether the GAMEPLAY_CAMERA_FOCUS is set to manual or automatic. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: CHASE CAMERA ZOOM SPEED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the speed modifier for when the zoom/FOV chase (external) camera changes zoom/FOV levels. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: CAMERA ACTION COCKPIT VIEW RESET
simvars.description: This can be used to reset the cockpit camera when the CAMERA STATE is set to 2 (Cockpit). Essentially the same as the user pressing the default reset keys CTRL + Space.

simvars.name: CAMERA ACTION COCKPIT VIEW SAVE
simvars.description: This can be used to save a cockpit camera when the CAMERA STATE is set to 2 (Cockpit). The index value given is the save "slot" that will be used, from 0 to 9. Essentially this is the same as the user pressing the default save keys CTRL + Alt + 0-9.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA HEADLOOK
simvars.description: This is used to get/set the look state of the cockpit camera. Note that this value will also affect the CAMERA SUBSTATE value, when the CAMERA STATE is set to 2 (Cockpit).

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA HEIGHT
simvars.description: This can be used to get/set the cockpit camera height modifier expressed as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA INSTRUMENT AUTOSELECT
simvars.description: This can be used to get or set the autoselect option for the cockpit camera when viewing the instruments (ie: the CAMERA SUBSTATE is 5). When enabled the camera will move automatically if the player mouse reaches the edge of the screen and there are instrument panels available on that side.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA MOMENTUM
simvars.description: Sets/gets the momentum modifier of the cockpit camera, which is controls how fast/slow the camera will stop moving when no longer being moved by the user. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA SIDE
simvars.description: Not currently used in the simulation.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA SPEED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the translation speed modifier of the cockpit camara, as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA UPPER POSITION
simvars.description: Sets/gets the current "upper position" cockpit camera toggle. When 1 (TRUE), the camera is is in the upper position, and when 0 (FALSE) it is in the default position.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA ZOOM
simvars.description: Sets/gets the zoom/FOV modifier for the cockpit camera. Note that when setting this value, it will affect the camera regardless of whether the GAMEPLAY_CAMERA_FOCUS is set to manual or automatic. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: COCKPIT CAMERA ZOOM SPEED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the speed modifier for when the zoom/FOV cockpit camera changes zoom/FOV levels. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA FOCUS
simvars.description: Sets/gets the focus modifier for the drone camera. Default is 50%, and a lower value will set the drone focus to things in the foreground and a higher level will set the drone focus to things in the background. Note that this is only taken into account when the DRONE CAMERA FOCUS MODE is set to 3 (manual).

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA FOCUS MODE
simvars.description: Sets/gets the current drone focus mode. When set to 3 (manual), the focus position will be based on the DRONE CAMERA FOCUS value.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA FOLLOW
simvars.description: Sets/gets the whether the drone camera is in follow mode or not.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA FOV
simvars.description: Sets/gets the zoom/FOV modifier for the drone camera. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA LOCKED
simvars.description: Sets/gets the whether the drone camera is locked or not.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA SPEED ROTATION
simvars.description: Sets/gets the rotation speed modifier of the drone camara, as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: DRONE CAMERA SPEED TRAVELLING
simvars.description: Sets/gets the translation speed modifier of the drone camara, as a percentage. Default is 50%.

simvars.name: SMART CAMERA ACTIVE
simvars.description: Sets/gets the whether the smart camera is active or not.

simvars.name: SMART CAMERA INFO
simvars.description: Gets information on the smartcam system. The index sets what kind of information will be returned (or set): 0 = Gets the number of smartcam targets in the smart camera list 1 = Gets or sets the index of the currently selected smartcam target, counting from 0 (so index 0 is the first target in the list).

simvars.name: SMART CAMERA LIST
simvars.description: Retrieves the type of target for the indexed position in the smartcam list, counting from 0 (so index 0 is the first target in the list).
units: Enum: 0 = unknown POI 1 = Follow POI 2 = User POI 3 = General POI 4 = End OF Runway 5 = Landing Runway 6 = Flightpath 7 = Object Interaction 8 = Multiplayer OOI 9 = Active Runway 10 = Waypoint 11 = Airport OOI 12 = Flight Assistant Destination

simvars.name: SMART CAMERA LIST DESCRIPTION
simvars.description: This returns a localized string that represents the smartcam target specified by the given index. Indices count from 0 so index 0 is the first target in the list.

simvars.name: BALLOON AUTO FILL ACTIVE
simvars.description: Sets / returns whether the balloon is creating air inside to emulate fans air flow or not.

simvars.name: BALLOON FILL AMOUNT
simvars.description: This is used to get / set the ratio of air within the balloon envelope from 0 (empty) to 1 (full).

simvars.name: BALLOON GAS DENSITY
simvars.description: The density of the gas inside the balloon.

simvars.name: BALLOON GAS TEMPERATURE
simvars.description: Temperature of the gas inside a balloon.

simvars.name: BALLOON VENT OPEN VALUE
simvars.description: This represents how open the "parachute valve" of a hot air balloon is, where 0 is fully closed and 1 is fully open.

simvars.name: BURNER FUEL FLOW RATE
simvars.description: The amount of fuel that is flowing through the named Burner expressed in lbs per hour.

simvars.name: BURNER HEATING POWER
simvars.description: This is the thermal power of the named (or indexed) Burner expressed in BTU per hour. If a value of 0 is given instead of a name (or index) then the sum total of all burners heating power will be returned.

simvars.name: BURNER PILOT LIGHT ON
simvars.description: The named (or indexed) hot air balloon Burner pilot light status, where 0 (FALSE) is off, and 1 (TRUE) is on. Note that of the burner is not receiving fuel this SimVar will revert to 0 (FALSE), if set to 1 (TRUE).

simvars.name: BURNER VALVE OPEN VALUE
simvars.description: This represents how open the the named (or indexed) burner Valve is, where 0 is fully closed and 1 is fully open.

simvars.name: GROUND ATTACHMENT
simvars.description: This toggles the status of the attachment rope. When 1 (true) the balloon has an attachment rope, and when 0 (false) it does not.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT GAS TYPE
simvars.description: Gets the type of gas being used by the named (or indexed) gas compartment.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT OVERPRESSURE
simvars.description: Gets the over-pressure value of the named (or indexed) gas compartment. Note that this value is commonly expressed using inWG, which is not a supported SimVar unit, therfore some conversion may need done on the value before display/use.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT PRESSURE
simvars.description: Gets the current pressure value of the named (or indexed) gas compartment. Note that this value is commonly expressed using inWG, which is not a supported SimVar unit, therfore some conversion may need done on the value before display/use.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT TEMPERATURE
simvars.description: Gets the current temperature value of the named (or indexed) gas compartment.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT VOLUME
simvars.description: Gets the volume of gas in the named (or indexed) gas compartment.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP COMPARTMENT WEIGHT
simvars.description: Gets the weight of gas in the named (or indexed) gas compartment.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP DAMPER STATE
simvars.description: Gets or sets the state of the named (or indexed) gas compartment damper. Note that dampers are not defined explicitly, but are added automatically by the simulation, one per-compartment that is of the gas type "Air". Non-air compartments do not have dampers.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP FAN POWER PCT
simvars.description: Gets or sets the state of the air intake fan for the named (or indexed) gas compartment. Note that air intake fans are not defined explicitly, but are added automatically by the simulation, one per-compartment that is of the gas type "Air". Non-air compartments do not have air intake fans.

simvars.name: AIRSHIP VALVE STATE
simvars.description: Gets or sets the state of the named (or indexed) valve.

simvars.name: MAST TRUCK DEPLOYMENT
simvars.description: This toggles the status of the mast truck. When 1 (true) the truck should deploy the mast and other stabilisers, and when 0 (false) it should retract the mast and other stabilisers.

simvars.name: MAST TRUCK EXTENSION
simvars.description: This is used to get / set the extension value of the mast from the mast truck (which needs to be deployed first), where a value of 0 is no extension and a value of 100 is full extension.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER ANGLE CURRENT
simvars.description: Current angle of the baggage loader ramp, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER ANGLE TARGET
simvars.description: Target angle of the baggage loader ramp, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER END RAMP Y
simvars.description: "Y" axis position of the end of the baggage loader ramp, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER END RAMP Z
simvars.description: "Z" axis position of the end of the baggage loader ramp, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER PIVOT Y
simvars.description: "Y" axis position of the baggage loader ramp pivot, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BAGGAGELOADER PIVOT Z
simvars.description: "Z" axis position of the baggage loader ramp pivot, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP ELEVATION CURRENT
simvars.description: The current altitude AGL of the top of the boarding ramp stairs.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP ELEVATION TARGET
simvars.description: The target altitude AGL of the top of the boarding ramp stairs.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP END POSITION Y
simvars.description: The "Y" axis position of the top of the boarding ramp stairs when extended at maximal capacity, relative to the ground.

simvars.name: BOARDINGRAMP ORIENTATION TARGET

simvars.name: CATERINGTRUCK ELEVATION TARGET

simvars.name: CATERINGTRUCK OPENING TARGET

simvars.name: FUELTRUCK HOSE END POSZ

simvars.name: GROUNDPOWERUNIT HOSE END POSZ

simvars.name: GROUNDPOWERUNIT HOSE END RELATIVE HEADING
simvars.description: The heading of the end of the ground power unit hose, relative to the vehicle heading.

simvars.description: In case scenery is not loaded for AI planes, this variable can be used to set a default surface elevation.

simvars.name: CATEGORY
simvars.description: One of the following: "Airplane", "Helicopter", "Boat", "GroundVehicle", "ControlTower", "SimpleObject", "Viewer"

simvars.name: CONTROLLABLE

simvars.description: Flag value that indicates the cause of a crash.
units: Enum: 0:[index] None 2:[index] Mountain 4:[index] General 6:[index] Building 8:[index] Splash 10:[index] Gear up 12:[index] Overstress 14:[index] Building 16:[index] Aircraft 18:[index] Fuel Truck

simvars.name: CRASH SEQUENCE
simvars.description: The state of the crash event sequence.
units: Enum: 0:[index] off 1:[index] complete 3:[index] reset 4:[index] pause 11:[index] start

simvars.description: Altitude of surface. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: HAND ANIM STATE
simvars.description: What frame of the hand is currently used.
units: Enum: 0 = Hover 1 = Index push/Point 2 = Pinch large 3 = Pinch medium 4 = Pinch small 5 = Pinch lateral 6 = Press all/Fist 7 = Toggle lever up/down 8 = Thumb push 9 = Holde yoke thin 10 = Hold throttle 11 = Hold yokes 12 = Push/pull lever

simvars.name: HIDE AVATAR IN AIRCRAFT
simvars.description: Return the status of the hide_avatar variable from the aircraft.cfg file.

simvars.name: IDLE ANIMATION ID
simvars.description: The ID of the idle animation for the sim object. Not used by the simulation.

simvars.name: MAGVAR
simvars.description: Magnetic variation. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: PARACHUTE OPEN
simvars.description: This will be TRUE if the parachute has opened and FALSE otherwise. Currently this is only applied to the Parachute SimObject used by Winches.

simvars.name: REALISM
simvars.description: General realism percent.

simvars.name: REALISM CRASH DETECTION
simvars.description: True indicates crash detection is turned on.

simvars.name: REALISM CRASH WITH OTHERS
simvars.description: True indicates crashing with other aircraft is possible.

simvars.name: SIM DISABLED
simvars.description: Is sim disabled.

simvars.name: SIM ON GROUND
simvars.description: On ground flag. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: SIM SHOULD SET ON GROUND
simvars.description: This is a "read only" flag that is only ever used internally and has no use to third parties. If you need to know if the user aircraft is on the ground then use IS ON GROUND, and if you need to set the aircraft on the ground then use SIMCONNECT_DATA_INITPOSITION.

simvars.name: TRACK IR ENABLE
simvars.description: Returns true if Track IR is enabled or not.

simvars.name: TOTAL WORLD VELOCITY
simvars.description: Speed relative to the earths center.

simvars.name: USER INPUT ENABLED
simvars.description: Is input allowed from the user.

simvars.name: VISUAL MODEL RADIUS
simvars.description: Model radius.

simvars.name: VELOCITY WORLD X
simvars.description: Speed relative to earth, in East/West direction. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: VELOCITY WORLD Y
simvars.description: Speed relative to earth, in vertical direction. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: VELOCITY WORLD Z
simvars.description: Speed relative to earth, in North/South direction. NOTE: This is available in multiplayer to all far aircraft. See here for more information: Note On SimVars In Multiplayer.

simvars.name: VR GROUP INTERACTION ON
simvars.description: This will return 1 (TRUE) if VR is on and group interaction is on. Otherwise it will return 0 (FALSE).

simvars.name: PYLON HEIGHT
simvars.description: The height of the pylon.

simvars.name: PYLON COLLISION POSITION
simvars.description: Distance to the collision object relative to the pylon.

simvars.name: AMBIENT DENSITY
simvars.description: Ambient density. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT IN CLOUD
simvars.description: True if the aircraft is in a cloud.

simvars.name: AMBIENT IN SMOKE
simvars.description: True if the camera position is flying through smoke. Note that if this is true, then the aircraft will be taking increased Wear and Tear damage. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the camera position, regardless of where the user aircraft is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT PRECIP RATE
simvars.description: The current precipitation rate. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT PRECIP STATE
simvars.description: The current state of precipitation. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT PRESSURE
simvars.description: Ambient pressure. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT TEMPERATURE
simvars.description: Ambient temperature. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT VISIBILITY
simvars.description: Ambient visibility (only measures ambient particle visibility - related to ambient density).

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND DIRECTION
simvars.description: Wind direction, relative to true north. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND VELOCITY
simvars.description: Wind velocity. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND X
simvars.description: Wind component in East/West direction. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND Y
simvars.description: Wind component in vertical direction. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AMBIENT WIND Z
simvars.description: Wind component in North/South direction. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: BAROMETER PRESSURE
simvars.description: Barometric pressure. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: DENSITY ALTITUDE
simvars.description: The density altitude is the altitude relative to standard atmospheric conditions at which the air density would be equal to the indicated air density at the place of observation. The calculation is as follows: density_altitude = pressure_altitude + 118.8 * (outside_air_temp - ISA_temp)

simvars.name: ENV CLOUD DENSITY
simvars.description: This SimVar returns the current density of the clouds at the position of the user aircraft. Density is expressed as a value between 0 and 1, where 0 is no clouds, and 1 is very dense cloud. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: ENV SMOKE DENSITY
simvars.description: This SimVar returns the current density of any smoke at the position of the camera. Density is expressed as a value between 0 and 1, where 0 is no smoke, and 1 is very dense smoke. Note that if this value is greater than 0 then the user aircraft will be taking Wear and Tear damage, and the higher the value the more damage will be taken. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the camera position, regardless of where the user aircraft is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: SEA LEVEL AMBIENT TEMPERATURE
simvars.description: The ambient temperature of the air at sea level. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: SEA LEVEL PRESSURE
simvars.description: Barometric pressure at sea level. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: STRUCT AMBIENT WIND
simvars.description: X (latitude), Y (vertical) and Z (longitude) components of the wind. NOTE: This SimVar will always be calculated from the user aircraft position, regardless of where the camera is, or what aircraft is selected.

simvars.name: AI DESIRED SPEED
simvars.description: The desired speed of the AI object.

simvars.name: AI WAYPOINT LIST
simvars.description: A list of waypoints that an AI controlled object should follow.

simvars.name: AI CURRENT WAYPOINT
simvars.description: The current waypoint in the list.

simvars.name: AI DESIRED HEADING
simvars.description: The desired heading of the AI object.

simvars.name: AI GROUNDTURNTIME
simvars.description: The time required by the AI aircraft to make a 90º turn.

simvars.name: AI GROUNDCRUISESPEED
simvars.description: The ground cruising speed for the AI aircraft.

simvars.name: AI GROUNDTURNSPEED
simvars.description: The ground turning speed for the AI aircraft.

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ISIFR
simvars.description: This can be used to request whether the AI aircraft is IFR or VFR. Note that if an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be 0 (or false).

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC STATE
simvars.description: This will return a string describing an AI aircraft state. If the aircraft is under ATC control the string will be one of the following: "init" "sleep" "flt plan" "startup" "preflight support" "clearance" "push back 1" "push back 2" "pre taxi out" "taxi out" "takeoff 1" "takeoff 2" "T&G depart" "enroute" "pattern" "landing" "rollout" "go around" "taxi in" "shutdown" "postflight support" If the aircraft is not under ATC control, the string will be one of these: "Sleep" "Waypoint" "Takeoff" "Landing" "Taxi" Note that if an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be an empty string "".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC CURRENT AIRPORT
simvars.description: The ICAO code of the current airport. If an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be an empty string "".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ASSIGNED RUNWAY
simvars.description: The assigned runway name (for example: "32R"). If an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be an empty string "".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ASSIGNED PARKING
simvars.description: The assigned parking name. The string will take the form: Name + Number, Type ( radius ) For example: "Ramp 1, RAMP sml (10m)" "Gate G 4, RAMP lrg (18m)" If an aircraft does not have a flight plan, the value returned will be an empty string "".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC FROMAIRPORT
simvars.description: The ICAO code of the departure airport in the current schedule. This variable is only valid for aircraft generated by the traffic database that have schedules. If an aircraft does not have a schedule, the value returned will an empty string"".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC TOAIRPORT
simvars.description: The ICAO code of the destination airport in the current schedule. This variable is only valid for aircraft generated by the traffic database that have schedules. If an aircraft does not have a schedule, the value returned will an empty string"".

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ETD
simvars.description: The estimated time of departure for the current schedule entry, given as the number of seconds difference from the current simulation time. This can be negative if ETD is earlier than the current simulation time This variable is only valid for aircraft generated by the traffic database that have schedules. If an aircraft does not have a schedule, the value returned will be 0.

simvars.name: AI TRAFFIC ETA
simvars.description: Estimated time of arrival for the current schedule entry, given as the number of seconds difference from the current simulated time. This can be negative if ETA is earlier than the current simulated time. This variable is only valid for aircraft generated by the traffic database that have schedules. If an aircraft does not have a schedule, the value returned will be 0.

simvars.description: No longer used by the simulation.

simvars.name: STRUCT PBH32
simvars.description: Returns a pitch, bank and heading value (for what will depend on the SimVar being used). No longer used by the simulation.

simvars.name: STRUCT REALISM VARS
simvars.description: No longer used by the simulation.

simvars.name: STRUCT SURFACE RELATIVE VELOCITY
simvars.description: The relative surface velocity.

simvars.name: STRUCT WORLDVELOCITY
simvars.description: The world velocity.

simvars.name: STRUCT WORLD ACCELERATION
simvars.description: The world acceleration for each axis. Individual world acceleration values are in the Aircraft Position and Speed section.

simvars.name: STRUCT WORLD ROTATION VELOCITY
simvars.description: The world rotation velocity.

simvars.name: ABSOLUTE TIME
simvars.description: This returns the seconds since 12:00 am 1/1/1AD Zulu Time See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU TIME
simvars.description: This returns the seconds since midnight (00:00 Zulu Time) on the current day.

simvars.name: ZULU DAY OF WEEK
simvars.description: This returns the current Zulu Time day of the week as an integer value between 0 and 6 (inclusive), where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU DAY OF MONTH
simvars.description: This returns the current Zulu Time day of the month as an integer value between 1 and 31 (inclusive). See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU MONTH OF YEAR
simvars.description: This returns the current Zulu Time month of the year as an integer value between 1 and 12 (inclusive), where 1 is January and 12 is December. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU DAY OF YEAR
simvars.description: This returns the current Zulu Time day of the year as an integer value between 0 and 365 (365 only on a leap year). See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU YEAR
simvars.description: This returns the current Zulu Time year as an integer value. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU SUNRISE TIME
simvars.description: This returns the seconds since midnight until the sunrise based on Zulu Time. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: ZULU SUNSET TIME
simvars.description: This returns the seconds since midnight until the sunset based on Zulu Time. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: LOCAL TIME
simvars.description: This returns the seconds since midnight (00:00 local time) on the current day.

simvars.name: LOCAL DAY OF WEEK
simvars.description: This returns the current day of the week as an integer value between 0 and 6 (inclusive), where 0 is Sunday and 6 is Saturday, within the local time reference.

simvars.name: LOCAL DAY OF MONTH
simvars.description: This returns the current day of the month as an integer value between 1 and 31 (inclusive), within the local time reference.

simvars.name: LOCAL MONTH OF YEAR
simvars.description: This returns the current month of the year as an integer value between 1 and 12 (inclusive), where 1 is January and 12 is December, within the local time reference.

simvars.name: LOCAL DAY OF YEAR
simvars.description: This returns the current day of the year as an integer value between 0 and 365 (365 only on a leap year), within the local time reference.

simvars.name: LOCAL YEAR
simvars.description: This returns the current year (local time) as an integer value.

simvars.name: TIME ZONE OFFSET
simvars.description: This returns the offset between the local time and Zulu Time. See the Note On Zulu Time for more information.

simvars.name: TIME OF DAY
simvars.description: This will return an integer value representing the approximate time of day where: 0 = dawn 1 = day 2 = dusk 3 = night

simvars.name: TOOLTIP UNITS
simvars.description: This will return an integer value representing the current units used to display tooltip information, where: 0 = default 1 = metric (SI) 2 = US (imperial)

simvars.name: UNITS OF MEASURE
simvars.description: This indicates the units used to express measurements and will return an integer value representing the following: 0 - English 1 - Metric with altitude in feet 2 - Metric with altitude in meters

simvars.name: SIMULATION RATE
simvars.description: This is used to get/set the internal rate of passing time within the simulation(independently of the visual frame rate). The value will be clamped between 0.0625 and 128, and a value of 1 means that 1 second of game time is the same as 1 second of "real" time, and lower values will make the game time slower, and higher values will make the game time faster. Values are always multiples of two starting at 0.0625, so you can have: 0.0625, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, ... 128

simvars.name: SIMULATION TIME
simvars.description: This returns a value for the seconds since the simulation has been started.

simvars.name: SIMULATION DELTA TIME
simvars.description: This returns a value for the time passed between the last simulation frame and the current one.

simvars.name: IS IN VR
simvars.description: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the simulation is in VR mode or not.

simvars.name: IS USING MOTION CONTROLLERS
simvars.description: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the user is using 6DoF controllers in VR or not.

simvars.name: IS USING JOYSTICK THROTTLE
simvars.description: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the user is manipulating the throttle with a joystick device or not.

simvars.name: IS IN RTC
simvars.description: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the simulation is currently running an RTC or not.

simvars.name: IS AVATAR
simvars.description: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the user is in "Avatar" mode or not.

simvars.name: IS AIRCRAFT
simvars.description: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the user is in "Aircraft" mode or not.

simvars.name: IS CAMERA LOCKED
simvars.description: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether the camera is locked or not.

simvars.name: EFB BRIGHTNESS
simvars.description: This return the brightness of the EFB, from 0 to 1. If it is set to "auto brightness" within the EFB's settings, then -1 will be returned.

simvars.name: SWITCH USER ALWAYS ALLOWED
simvars.description: This returns either 1 (TRUE) or 0 (FALSE) to indicate whether there is no limitation to switch between avatar and aircraft mode or not.
